description:
Problem: protocol.history() (protocol.py:290-307) keeps any benchbox-oracle[bot] review that is not DISMISSED and decodes its unsigned marker, without edit state; github.oracle_reviews (github.py:132-145) reads REST, which has no edit fields. A write-access account (GitHub's Write role can edit anyone's PR comments; oracle-review-v2.md:819-821 says agents share such an account) can edit an App review's marker to decision SHIP and patch_digest of a new unreviewed patch (computable offline via local.file_states + protocol.patch_digest). plan_round then CARRYs (protocol.py:412-428), report.carried posts a fresh unedited App review with this run's run id and a success status, and oracle-gate passes. Editing patch_map narrows a follow-up to a trivial file (changed_paths). Same root cause in other readers of App-authored text: soundness_merge_digest.py:252-270,415-425,482-485 decides oracle success from review bodies and :406-415,:631-633 takes open-finding severities from App thread first comments; dedup.open_fingerprints (dedup.py:33-49) trusts App inline-comment markers; cli._disputed_threads (cli.py:195-229, via protocol.thread_finding) keys disputes from the App thread's first comment. The guard re-read (_reread_history, cli.py:935-953) returns an empty History after three failures.

Outcome: every reader of App-authored protocol state fails closed on edited objects and never posts on unreadable edit state.
(1) oracle_reviews carries node_id; one batched GraphQL read of lastEditedAt/includesCreatedEdit (reuse oracle_review_check.fetch_review_edit's query shape) covers every marked App review. Edited -> history() returns History([], 'an oracle review was edited') and the plan HOLDs. Edit state unreadable (GraphQL error, missing node_id or fields) -> the plan step exits non-zero and posts nothing, so a decided head's latest App status stays as it was. Applies at both call sites (plan cli.py:437 and the guard).
(2) The guard's give-up path fails the run (non-zero, no post) instead of reporting no decision.
(3) On CARRY, cross-check the recorded decision against the App's oracle-verdict status for previous head_sha: use only App-created statuses (the _verdict_statuses creator filter in oracle_review_check.py:163-174), choosing the one whose description carries the record's [run <id>]; for a record with no run id, the latest App success or failure. success iff the recorded decision is SHIP; SHIP WITH FIXES, DO NOT SHIP and REFUSED require failure (report.py:425, attempts.py:95-96). Mismatch or no such status -> HOLD.
(4) soundness_merge_digest: count a review as oracle evidence only if unedited and its decision agrees with the App status chosen as in (3); report severities from edited App thread first comments, and any review failing the check, as unverifiable.
(5) dedup ignores fingerprints from edited App comments; dispute binding ignores disputes under an edited App first comment; unreadable edit state -> not deduplicated and not bound.

Decision gates:
1. Before coding: one read-only GraphQL query against an existing App review and an App review comment on a merged PR (e.g. #3561) shows lastEditedAt and includesCreatedEdit are returned for Bot-authored PullRequestReview and PullRequestReviewComment (the batch review confirmed the review half on #3575, #3562, #3570). If the comment fields are unavailable, stop and ask the owner.
2. If the plan job's token cannot run the GraphQL read with its current permissions (pull-requests: read), stop and ask; never widen permissions silently. (The sweep already reads statuses with the same permission set, cli.py:1057.)
3. Before make pr-arm on this PR: (a) list open PRs to develop whose marked App reviews or comments show includesCreatedEdit=true and record the list; if non-empty, tell the owner which PRs will HOLD after merge (owner stand-in is their recovery, owner decision 2026-10-27); (b) exposure audit: list merged PRs since 2026-10-08 whose App reviews or comments show includesCreatedEdit=true and record it; if any, tell the owner; (c) own-PR check: every benchbox-oracle[bot] review and review comment on this PR has includesCreatedEdit=false and its SHIP came from a fresh (not CARRY) run on the exact head; otherwise stop and ask the owner.
4. HMAC signing is out of scope (owner decision); it is its own later item.
5. If this PR's first review raises findings while the concedes fix (#3585) is unmerged, push no fix and request no /oracle-review until it merges.

Item guardrails: fail closed everywhere (edited -> HOLD; unreadable, missing node_id or GraphQL error -> error exit with no post; never carry); do not change gate semantics in oracle_review_check.py beyond what (3)/(4) need; no new secrets; one GraphQL round trip per plan where possible (batch by node ids).
